name: Niigata

flag.description: A gold emblem on a red field: the kanji 新 (nii) at the top of a ring formed by the katakana ガタ (gata).
flag.symbolism: The emblem spells Niigata, and the ring, like a necklace, stands for harmony, hope and smooth growth.

hook: Niigata's gold ring on red spells its own name: 新 (nii) sits on top of a loop of ガタ (gata).
trivia: Niigata is famous for Koshihikari rice and for its sake.
Sado Island, off the coast, had one of Japan's richest gold mines.
